description: This file serves as the server entry point for a Remix application, handling HTTP requests by rendering React components into streams, managing CORS headers, and differentiating request handling for bots and browsers.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main request handler that sets CORS headers, handles OPTIONS requests, and delegates to bot or browser request handlers based on user-agent.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles requests identified as coming from bots, streaming server-side rendered React components.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles requests from browsers, streaming server-side rendered React components.
